title: Mid-semester exam schedule released
description: The timetable for the upcoming mid-semester examinations has been published. Exams begin on November 10. Please check your course dashboard for specific room allocations.

title: Campus Wi-Fi maintenance shutdown
description: The campus Wi-Fi network will undergo scheduled maintenance this Saturday from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM. Internet services in the library and dorms will be temporarily unavailable.

title: Annual sports meet registration open
description: Registrations for football, basketball, and track & field events are now live. Interested students must submit their applications before the end of the month.

title: Library extended study hours
description: The Learning Resource Centre will remain open until 10:00 PM on weekdays during the examination period.

title: Student portal maintenance
description: StudentHub will be unavailable for planned maintenance on Sunday between 1:00 AM and 3:00 AM.
